milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the cracked stone bricks in the ruined structure and face toward them. Target is set to (8, 1, 6) which is the most prominent cracked stone brick on the front wall of the ruin, visible at eye level from the approach direction. max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) to ensure the player must actually walk to the structure — spawn is ~10 blocks away, so the player needs to cover at least ~5 blocks of distance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block, modeling 'the player can see the target.'

scene_description: A small ruined outpost made primarily of stone bricks, with several cracked stone bricks scattered throughout its walls. The structure is located ~8 blocks from spawn in the +X/+Z direction. Additional minor structures (oak planks shed, cobblestone wall) provide visual context. A villager wanders nearby. The player must explore and locate the cracked stone bricks within the ruin walls.
task_text: Find cracked stone bricks in the nearby ruined structure.
design_notes: Cracked stone bricks are placed at 4 locations within the ruin: front wall at (~8,1,6) and (~7,2,6), floor at (~9,0,7), and right wall at (~10,2,8). The structure is 5x5 blocks with 3 walls (west wall has a doorway). The player spawns ~8 blocks away and can see the structure from spawn. The 'find' task requires the player to get close enough to have cracked_stone_bricks in their field of view. Additional structures add realism without blocking navigation.
